pageDescription: Configure Amazon authentication, HomeKit devices, Alexa routines and advanced options.
accountHelp: These settings are used for the initial browser authentication.
devicesHelp: Choose which Alexa devices should appear in HomeKit. Previously discovered accessories are offered as suggestions.
routinesHelp: Expose selected routines as momentary HomeKit switches. Existing routine accessories are offered as suggestions.
completeLogin: Complete the Amazon login in the newly opened page. Devices will be retrieved automatically afterwards.
proxyStarting: The authentication proxy is starting. Open the displayed link after a few seconds.
proxyReady: The authentication proxy is ready. Open the Amazon login page.
checkingAuthentication: Checking whether Amazon authentication has completed…
authCheckTimedOut: The authentication status could not be confirmed. Select Refresh devices to check again.
requestTimedOut: The settings server did not respond.
authenticationFailed: The Alexa authentication proxy could not be started.
securityNotice: This plugin does not ask for or store your Amazon user ID or password. Authentication takes place on the Amazon login page, and only the resulting session data is stored inside Homebridge.
discoveryComplete: Alexa devices and routines were retrieved.
discoveringAlexa: Retrieving Alexa devices and routines. This may take a little while…
discoveryContinues: Discovery is taking longer than expected. You can continue using the settings page and select Refresh devices again later.
discoveryRenderFailed: Devices were retrieved, but the list could not be displayed. Check the browser developer console.
executionDevice: Execution Echo name or serial number
required: Authentication host and port are required.
